AP News is the Associated Press's platform for breaking news, latest headlines, and videos covering global events with independent journalism.

📖 Explanation  
The Associated Press (AP) is a well-known, not-for-profit American news agency founded in 1846. It provides up-to-date news from around the world, covering various topics like politics, sports, and more. You can access their latest stories and videos on their official website APNews.com or through their newsroom for recent content.

If you want the latest headlines or breaking news, AP News is a reliable source trusted worldwide.
